schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One PR a month with every minor and patch. Majors still come one by one.

Vendored upstream manifests: the images and the CRDs/RBAC next to them must move together. Flux itself is handled by the flux manager; flux-operator and MetalLB are re-vendored by hand from their release.
linuxserver.io tags: <version>[ubuNNNN]-lsNNN. The ls build bumps on every rebuild of the same upstream version.
Postgres majors need a dump/restore (or pg_upgrade) of the data dir. Done by hand, never by a PR.
Its tag encodes the VectorChord/pgvector versions the server needs; follow the Immich release notes instead.
Server and machine-learning must run the same version, majors included.
